description: Na₂Zr₂O₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Zr is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ZrO₅ square pyramids. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and four longer (2.07 Å) Zr-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Zr atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Zr₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
